description: Styles for the Tic Tac Toe game frontend, defining color variables, layout, and responsive design for game components.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main container component for the Tic Tac Toe game, centered on the screen with a clean layout.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Displays the current status of the game, such as whose turn it is or if the game has ended.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Layout component that organizes the squares of the Tic Tac Toe board in a responsive grid format.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Individual square component for the Tic Tac Toe game, representing a cell on the board.

classes.name: restart-button
classes.description: Button component for restarting the game, styled to match the overall game theme.
